en.title: This Bird Is Immune to Bee Stings. Can You Name It?
en.description: This is the rainbow bee-eater. It is immune to bee and wasp stings, yet rubs a captured bee's stinger against a perch while closing its eyes to avoid the venom, and it can spot an insect from 45 meters away.
